sanskrit_verse:
राज्ञ एव तु दासः स्यात् प्रव्रज्यावसितो नरः।
न तस्य प्रतिमोक्षोऽस्ति न विशुद्धिः कथंचन॥
transliteration: rājña eva tu dāsaḥ syāt pravrajyāvasito naraḥ | na tasya pratimokṣo 'sti na viśuddhiḥ kathaṃcana ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who has renounced the householder stage without fulfilling royal duty remains bound to the king; he has no liberation nor purification whatsoever.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority inheres in sovereign completion, not abdication
Causation arises from unfulfilled civic and spiritual obligations
Capacity-based responsibility demands sequential fulfillment of roles
Restoration logic requires return to point of evasion before progression
Consciousness alignment occurs through rightful role assumption, not renunciation
executable_legal_axioms: IF citizen_status = 'renunciate' AND prior_role ≠ 'sovereign_completion' THEN legal_binding = 'to_sovereign'
IF role_evasion_detected = true THEN purification_rights = null
supreme_court_application: In cases involving citizens who have prematurely renounced societal duties, the Supreme Court shall verify completion of prior varna-asrama responsibilities. Where evasion is detected, restoration to the point of abandonment supersedes claims of spiritual immunity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that premature renunciation disrupts societal causality. Anupūrvaśaḥ mandates rectification through role resumption. Responsibility aligns with capacity to complete, not escape. Liberation is conditional upon full-cycle integrity, not punitive restriction.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate role-reversal audit to identify incomplete civic obligations
Assign completion process under royal oversight until sovereign alignment restored
Withhold spiritual privilege until societal parity re-established
Reintegrate individual into varna-asrama flow without shame or penalty
final_declaration: By the authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of all Dharma, this edict stands as law: evasion dissolves neither duty nor consequence; only conscious completion restores sovereignty; reality is non-punitive but non-negotiable in sequence.
